title: Controls
lead: The home button and controller behaviour. Keyboard and mouse always work alongside the gamepad.

tester.title: Controller tester
tester.standard: Standard mapping · press any button to test it
tester.connect: Connect a controller and press a button.

capture.title: Press the new buttons
capture.message: Hold the buttons together on any controller, then let go of all of them: two to four buttons, or Home on its own. Press Escape or click Cancel to stop.

combo.overlapsKeyboard: Those buttons overlap the on-screen keyboard’s: pick others.
combo.overlapsHome: Those buttons overlap the home button’s: pick others.

enabled.label: Home button opens the overlay
enabled.description: Power, display, sound and music over any game, with back to game, PlayOut and quit.

hold.label: Hold time
hold.description: How long the buttons must be held before the overlay opens.

steam.label: Take the Guide button from Steam
steam.description: PlayOut turns off Steam's "Guide button focuses Steam" and "Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game" (Steam restarts quietly) and puts them back when you turn this off.
steam.onlyWithHome: Steam only matters while the buttons include Home.

gameBar.label: Turn off Xbox Game Bar
gameBar.description: So it never opens over the overlay: its controller shortcuts and links are turned off, and Game Bar is closed if something still starts it. Everything is put back when you turn this off.

pause.label: Pause the game while the overlay is open
pause.description: The game is frozen so it takes none of your buttons, and runs on when the overlay closes. Games with anti-cheat, and competitive online games (Online Multiplayer › All Competitive), are never paused.

touchSwipe.label: Swipe from the left to open the overlay
touchSwipe.description: On a touchscreen, swipe right from the left side of the screen during a game. Start a finger's width in from the edge: Windows keeps the very edge for its own swipe.

ingame.title: In-game overlay
ingame.label: In-game overlay
ingame.description: Over a game in exclusive full screen, PlayOut draws its overlay inside the game so the game does not minimize. Never for games with anti-cheat.
ingame.neverDescription: Gets the window overlay (it may minimize in exclusive full screen).
ingame.allowLabel: Use the in-game overlay for {title} again

keyboard.title: On-screen keyboard
keyboard.note: Opens Windows’ on-screen keyboard over any game or in PlayOut, to type with the controller.

deadzone.label: Stick dead zone
deadzone.description: Stick travel ignored before a direction registers.

vibration.label: Vibration
vibration.description: A short rumble when you select something.

swapAB.label: Swap A and B
swapAB.description: Nintendo-style layout: B selects and A goes back.

delay.label: Repeat delay
delay.description: How long a direction must be held before focus starts repeating.

rate.label: Repeat rate
rate.description: Time between repeated moves while a direction is held.
